_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 19: September 2025. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He wonders aloud whether a woman posting online is watching their videos and hearing them pray, says he is not trying to cause hype, and that he is only telling people what they are praying is coming.
mentions.quote: ain't trying to cause hype. I'm just trying to tell you what we are praying
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a clip claiming intelligence has confirmed terrorists who cannot be tracked and telling people to be cautious, and says it stood out to him though he does not know who she is.
mentions.quote: we cannot track these people. terrorists. Please be cautious
mentions.falsify_match: Not his claim; unattributed online material he amplifies.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a report that the UK government wants people to hold a digital ID on their phones and says this lines up with the beast system, coming from the head of the United Kingdom at a meeting.
mentions.quote: This lines up with the beast system
mentions.falsify_match: A mandatory UK digital ID scheme becoming a condition of work or payment.
mentions.falsify_miss: The scheme stays voluntary or is dropped.

mentions.claim_text: He says the digital ID will be required for your job and to pay for your goods, then the cell phone is done away with and it is put in your right hand or your forehead, just as the Bible said.
mentions.quote: they put it in your hand, your right hand or your forehead
mentions.falsify_match: An implanted identity or payment device in the hand or forehead required for commerce.

mentions.claim_text: He recalls telling viewers back in March that they must pray over the FAA, and that he saw planes falling out of the sky with confusion and mass chaos in the air and aircraft grounded.
mentions.quote: I saw planes coming out and they were falling out of the sky
mentions.falsify_match: An FAA systems failure grounding US aircraft, with a March 2025 statement locatable in the corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such failure, or no prior statement.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord told him the sheep and the goat nations would be presented concerning the UN, that exactly that happened during the 23rd, and that he said back in March or April it would be a hot spot and circled it.
mentions.quote: sheep and the goat nations would be presented in the days ahead concerning the UN
mentions.falsify_match: A UN vote splitting nations for and against Israel around 23 September 2025, with the March or April statement locatable.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such split, or no prior statement.

mentions.claim_text: He says Texas tries to secede from the union, telling the rest they are nuts and that Texas will stay and do its own thing, alongside gun freedom, and that this is what comes in the days ahead because he saw it.
mentions.quote: Texas tries to secede from the union
mentions.falsify_match: A formal secession movement in Texas reaching the legislature or a ballot.

mentions.claim_text: He warns against assuming things are fine because Trump is behind the wheel, and says people must start praying now for the 2026 elections to put the right people in the Senate, the House and the governorships and to keep Texas strong.
mentions.quote: You must start to pray now for our elections in 2026
mentions.falsify_match: Republican gains in the 2026 midterms.

mentions.claim_text: He declares an expiration date on the flood and the hell the viewer is going through, that their marriage turns around tonight and their healing is right there, and says they either believe it or they do not.
mentions.quote: There's an expiration date to the hell that you're going through
mentions.condition_text: you either believe it or you don't
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: private outcome with a belief condition.

mentions.claim_text: He notes the generals being called in next week, says he does not think it is coincidence unless they are all simply being fired, and that something bigger than meets the eye is behind it.
mentions.quote: there's something a lot bigger than what meets the eye
mentions.falsify_match: A major military or command decision emerging from that gathering.

mentions.claim_text: He points out that this time last year the man was not even president, and that the Lord told them in the January and February time frame, so they knew something significant was coming.
mentions.quote: this time last year he weren't even president
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable as framing; the underlying prior word is not restated here.

mentions.claim_text: He says people came in secretly and are in fifty gallon drums planning an attack worse than the eleventh of September, another wave, and that the Lord said they must pray, given even before the Iran and Israel twelve day war.
mentions.quote: they're in 50 gallon drums planning an attack worse than September
mentions.falsify_match: A mass casualty attack on American soil exceeding 11 September 2001, using drum containers.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such attack, credited to prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He gives thanks for what happened that day, says the Lord is on the throne, and that he knows in his spirit there will be more in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: I know in my spirit there's more
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: framing.

mentions.claim_text: He calls prayer for the nation and the elections from the watch on the wall, and says he saw it trying to flip to a stalemate government, with the Lord saying they must pray.
mentions.quote: I saw it trying to flip to a stalemate government
mentions.falsify_match: A split Congress after the 2026 midterms.
mentions.falsify_miss: One party holds both chambers, credited to prayer.

mentions.claim_text: He says God will have his glorious church rise up with healings and demonstrations of glory like they have never seen before, and that viewers will remember this day and recall what he said.
mentions.quote: healings and demonstrations and manifestations of the glory like we've never seen
mentions.falsify_match: A healing revival of unprecedented documented scale.

mentions.claim_text: He explains that when they pray and uncover things, what they say can trigger what people already know in the natural, drawing not only demonic attention but natural attention too.
mentions.quote: it brings not only demonic attention, but natural attention
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is another stated reason for withholding material.

mentions.claim_text: He models a confession that his children will be blessed coming in and going out, will serve God, be on fire for God and not go to hell, and says that is where you have to stand even when they act otherwise.
mentions.quote: My children will serve God. My children will not go to hell
mentions.condition_text: conditioned on standing on the confession
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a confession about private outcomes.

mentions.claim_text: He says the devil does not know the day or the hour either but can read the signs like anyone, that he is not omnipresent and is one devil in one place at a time, whereas the Holy Spirit is everywhere and in every believer.
mentions.quote: He's not omniresent. He doesn't He's not everywhere
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: teaching.

mentions.claim_text: He warns of what is coming in the church as another tier of the puzzle alongside crypto, AI and wars and rumours of wars, and reports that there will be a shaking in the finances and a shaking in the church.
mentions.quote: there'll be a shaking in the finances. There'll be a shakin
mentions.falsify_match: A financial crisis and a church crisis arriving together.

mentions.claim_text: He says it feels like a major heartbeat rather than a flatline right now, and that next week is a very important week that will lay a lot of things to rest as they come into the 23rd.
mentions.quote: Next week is a very very very uh important week
mentions.falsify_match: Something decisive in the week of the UN General Assembly, 23 September 2025.

mentions.claim_text: He plays a European official saying majorities will be difficult, that everyone must take responsibility, and that a Palestine donor group will be set up next month.
mentions.quote: we will set up a Palestine donor group next month
mentions.falsify_match: Not his claim; the policy statement he is reacting to.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are coming up with a two-state solution plan for the week of the 21st to 23rd, the main week of the UN, following what was voted on the 11th, and that it will unfold further in the days ahead.
mentions.quote: they're coming up with a plan for a two-state solution for the week
mentions.falsify_match: Formal recognitions of a Palestinian state at the UN in that week.

mentions.claim_text: He prays that the uncovering be like a light with the cockroaches running everywhere but Holy Ghost Raid getting them, and that there is judgment to seed, time and harvest.
mentions.quote: the cockroaches may be running everywhere, but raid's going to get them
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: intercession over an unnamed exposure.

mentions.claim_text: He says it is time to be hot or cold with no lukewarm and no riding the fence, and that they are in the last of the last seconds before the coming of Christ.
mentions.quote: We are in the last of the last seconds here before the coming
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: an imminence claim with no date, sharper in wording than the earlier last days language.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts a man caught up by a whirlwind and told by the Lord I am giving you a ten year window, and ties it to the next shmita cycle.
mentions.quote: I'm giving you a 10-year window
mentions.falsify_match: Another person's ten year window, which sits against his own four year one.

mentions.claim_text: He says he was shocked and disappointed to see how many countries including Canada and England voted for a two-state solution, and that this is the line drawn in the sand the Lord warned was coming, of who is for and who is against.
mentions.quote: that would be drawn in the sand of who is for and who is against
mentions.falsify_match: A visible international split over recognition of a Palestinian state, which occurred in September 2025.

mentions.claim_text: Prayer that sex traffickers be caught and brought to justice and that the fentanyl stops coming over the border and the fentanyl pandemic stops now.
mentions.quote: the fent fentanyl pandemic stops now
mentions.falsify_match: A measurable fall in fentanyl deaths and trafficking prosecutions.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is tired and his flesh is done and has to end and get rest, thanking viewers and saying he prays for every one of them.
mentions.quote: My flesh is my flesh is done. I've got to get rest
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: sign off.

mentions.claim_text: He believes the fire starts with young people on college campuses, who become spiritual rather than physical arsonists setting it ablaze the way William Seymour did.
mentions.quote: not saying physical arsonist but spiritual arsonist
mentions.falsify_match: A campus revival movement comparable to Azusa Street.

mentions.claim_text: He specifies the timing as not next week but the week after, roughly two weeks out from what he sees.
mentions.quote: not next week, but the next week. So, basically two weeks
mentions.falsify_match: Something of note in the week of 21 September 2025.
mentions.falsify_miss: That week passes without it, though the content is not stated here.

mentions.claim_text: He describes turmoil in the spirit realm around a September to remember, and says what he saw in the news headlines was specifically called the shot heard around the world.
mentions.quote: the shot was heard around the world. That's what I saw in the news headlines
mentions.falsify_match: A killing or single act in September 2025 described in headlines as the shot heard around the world.
